decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and other threats, while also maintaining card advantage through Treasure Cruise and Consider. It utilizes cheap spells and cantrips to trigger prowess and bring back the Phoenix for repeated damage. Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe provide removal options, while Brazen Borrower offers flexibility as a bounce spell or creature. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Profit's Eidetic Memory allows for powerful late-game plays. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive while maintaining card advantage and flexibility in its spells.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Invoke Despair to control the game. It also aims to remove threats with spells like Go for the Throat, Fatal Push, and Murderous Rider. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the board. Additionally, Graveyard Trespasser and Gifted Aetherborn provide both aggression and defense. The deck also includes lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Field of Ruin to support its strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells and combo off efficiently. By using cards like Pore Over the Pages and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field, and utilizing Hidden Strings and Into the Flood Maw to further generate mana, the deck aims to cast game-winning spells such as Dig Through Time or Artist's Talent. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Consider and Sleight of Hand to find the necessary pieces for the combo.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggression, utilizing cards like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while pushing damage with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Fear of Missing Out provides additional pressure, while Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offer powerful late-game threats. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and Fatal Push to control the board, ensuring the opponent is on the back foot. Overall, this deck aims to be proactive and punishing, keeping the pressure on the opponent from the start.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and board control using sacrifice synergies. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using cards like Mayhem Devil and Fatal Push, you can dominate the battlefield and deal damage to your opponent. Additionally, cards like Scavenger's Talent and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide value and card advantage. The deck aims to pressure opponents early on and maintain control throughout the game with a combination of creatures, removal spells, and sacrifice outlets.

The main focus of this aggro Red Deck Wins Pioneer 1 vs 1 archetype is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently to control the board and finish off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. With a mix of creatures with haste and burn spells, the deck puts pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game, aiming to close out matches in the early turns. Additionally, the deck includes some utility lands like Mutavault to provide additional threats and flexibility.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent by using efficient creatures like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Emberheart Challenger, while also having direct damage spells like Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of versatile cards like Manifold Mouse and Tersa Lightshatter helps to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The deck's strategy is to constantly apply pressure and force the opponent to react or risk losing quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Dovin's Veto, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and Supreme Verdict to control the board and prevent the opponent from developing threats. It also includes card draw spells like Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea to maintain card advantage. The addition of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by flickering permanents and generating card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until victory.

This Mono White Control deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells and counters, while also generating card advantage and value. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents for more ETB effects. The deck also includes a variety of threats like Elspeth, Storm Slayer and The Wandering Emperor to apply pressure and close out the game. The mana base is set up to consistently cast spells and activate abilities, ensuring a smooth and efficient gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and ensure victory. Additionally, the deck features various ways to pump up its creatures and deal additional damage, such as Blade of the Oni and Torch the Tower. The mana base is carefully constructed to support a smooth and consistent aggressive strategy.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the Retraction Helix combo with cards like Rona, Herald of Invasion and Stormchaser's Talent to generate quick and efficient board presence. By combining bounce effects and mana acceleration with Mox Amber and Mox Jasper, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells like Thundertrap Trainer and Stock Up. Narset, Parter of Veils helps to control the opponent's hand size, while other utility cards like This Town Ain't Big Enough and March of Swirling Mist provide additional support for the combo strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal, and card draw effects to outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence with powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck also includes a variety of utility lands to enhance its control capabilities. Ultimately, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. Utilizing cards like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage to pump up your creatures and deal more damage. The deck also includes burn spells like Claim / Fame and Reckless Rage to control the board and finish off your opponent. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of early game threats and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Mockingbird and Faerie Miscreant, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. By combining efficient removal spells with evasive threats, the deck aims to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. Additionally, cards like Moon-Circuit Hacker and Thousand-Faced Shadow provide additional evasion and resilience to removal, while cards like Enduring Curiosity and Spyglass Siren provide additional card advantage and disruption options. The deck aims to close out the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting your opponent's hand and board with cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Liliana of the Veil. It also aims to outvalue your opponent with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while using cards like Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber to gain card advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and Murderous Rider to deal with threats, and it has a strong mana base with Castle Locthwain, Mutavault, and utility lands like Field of Ruin.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also removing threats with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck aims to control the board and grind out value with powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It also has a strong late-game presence with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Gifted Aetherborn, while utilizing lands like Mutavault and Castle Locthwain for additional advantage. The deck is built around resource management and attrition to outlast opponents.
